## What changed?

Describe the checker behavior, rule, documentation, or test change.

## Why?

Explain the problem being solved and why this change is safe for a public pre-moderation checker.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run audit` passes, or I explained why the browser audit could not run locally
- [ ] I added/updated a regression fixture when checker behavior changed
- [ ] I updated `checks.csv` when check metadata changed
- [ ] I linked the current official Yandex Games documentation when changing requirement/recommendation interpretation
- [ ] This change adds no telemetry, external uploads, score writes, purchase/save mutation, or production side effects

## Related discussion / issue

Link the relevant Discussion or Issue if one exists.
